description: Open, content-addressed cancellation references over the AlgoVoi substrate (RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256). cancellation_ref = "sha256:" + SHA-256(JCS({cancellation_reason, mandate_ref})). The mandate_ref is the spend authority being cancelled, imported by hash: cn-001/002/003 cancel mandate_1 (sha256:a4f8cb5e...) which is the mandate_ref spend_guardrail_lite binds and payment_mandate_lite produces, so the cancellation composes onto the live decision chain. cancellation_reason is a closed enum {USER_REQUESTED, MERCHANT_REQUESTED, COMPLIANCE_TERMINATED, EXPIRED}; a reason outside the enum or an empty mandate_ref is rejected, not hashed. Both fields are byte-load-bearing. Lite tier: no signature; the commercial Cancellation Receipt adds Falcon-1024 PQC signing, effective-from timing, provider + jurisdiction, and cross-chain propagation.
note_chain: mandate_ref sha256:a4f8cb5e... is mandate_1 in payment_mandate_lite_v1 / spend_guardrail_lite_v1; cancellation_ref binds a categorical reason to that exact authority, closing the lifecycle on the authority side.

negatives.note: same mandate, different reason; cancellation_ref diverges (== cn-002)
same reason, different mandate; a cancellation cannot be re-pointed to another authority

negatives.reason: cancellation_reason must be one of the closed enum; an unknown reason is rejected, not hashed
mandate_ref must be a non-empty string; an empty field is rejected, not hashed

invariants.assert: changing either {cancellation_reason, mandate_ref} changes cancellation_ref (cn-001, reason-swap, mandate-swap all distinct)
a reason outside the closed enum and an empty mandate_ref are both rejected
